台站档案册应当可合并: The station profile book should be mergeable
备份里的野外台站要带过来: The field station in the backup must be brought over
家里那条去重、野外那条新增: The home one is de-duplicated, the field one is new
当前台站仍取本机: The current station still comes from the local data
旧备份不能让本机掉星: An old backup must not cost the local data its stars
本机损坏时要采纳备份: When the local data is corrupt, adopt the backup
没有日期就谈不上重复，一律并入: Without a date there is no duplication, so everything is merged in
